text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The summer camp is about to begin. The other students are motivated, but Vodka declares that she doesn't have time for camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, after a scolding from her father, Vodka makes it on the bus, albeit a little late.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing now that summer is about making memories with your friends, Vodka's spirited summer camp begins!
